snapshots.title: Setup with Tailwind and Panda CSS
snapshots.content:
Official setup guides: https://mystic-ui.vercel.app/docs/tailwind/setup and https://mystic-ui.vercel.app/docs/panda/setup.

Start with a SolidJS project using the chosen CSS framework and follow its official initialization steps. The Tailwind setup selects the Tailwind variant and requires a manually defined cn utility at the configured utils alias, using clsx and tailwind-merge. The Panda setup selects the Panda variant and includes @pandacss/preset-panda in the Panda configuration's presets.

Keep each variant's component source and generated CSS together. Col's previews use the source-pinned Tailwind 3 components and corresponding registry animation configuration. The official website's embedded stories render the Panda variant, including on Tailwind documentation pages.

Orbiting Circles
snapshots.content:
Tailwind OrbitingCircles accepts duration, delay, radius, path, reverse and class with children. Defaults are 20 seconds, 0 seconds, 50 pixels, true and false. The example uses 80 and 160 pixel radii, 10 second delays, and reverse motion on its outer pair. Documented SolidJS example: ```tsx import { OrbitingCircles } from "@/ui/orbiting-circles"; import { TbBrand4chan, TbBrandBitbucket, TbBrandGithubFilled, TbBrandReddit, } from "solid-icons/tb"; export default function OrbitingCirclesDemo() { return (
Circles
); } ``` Source revision: c7b3f1e9150c0474d8a5e62f807c8312e0e4b17f. Preserve the source component classes and its matching theme/animation CSS. Preview compilation uses SolidJS 1.9.17 and babel-preset-solid 1.9.16. This snapshot and preview use the Tailwind 3 variant; the official page also offers Panda CSS. Latest upstream commit checked on 2026-10-30 is dated 2024-12-24. The upstream alpha status is not a guarantee of current maintenance. The documented example additionally imports `solid-icons`; these are demo requirements, separate from the component dependency graph.
